parameters.content:
## Optional extension point

No LLM API key is used anywhere in this template. 
This JobOps step could optionally be extended with an AI Agent node + Chat Model, inserted between "Prepare Reviews Update" and "Append to Narrative", to interpret the reply text and suggest a structured action instead of a plain free-text note.

## Part of the JobOps Template

In live use (triggered via the router, itself triggered by a reply to the Reviews digest message), chatId is supplied automatically (no setup needed).

**If you test/execute this workflow standalone** (the "Called by Router" trigger, not through a live reply), there's nothing upstream to populate chatId; you must enter a real chat ID yourself as test input, or the confirmation/error message can't be sent. 
Find yours: message this template's bot once → open **JobOps Template Bot Router** → click the **JobOps Template Bot Trigger** node → **Listen for test event** → send another message → read `message.chat.id` from the captured output.

See **JobOps Template - Application Reminders** / **JobOps Template - Reviews Digest** for the two workflows that always need a real chat ID hardcoded.

## Setup required: jobops_template_config Data Table ID (always, no exceptions)

This workflow looks up the Airtable base/table IDs it needs from an n8n Data Table (D-24) rather than hardcoding them or using n8n Variables (gated behind a paid plan). The placeholder `YOUR_JOBOPS_TEMPLATE_CONFIG_DATA_TABLE_ID` in the **Load Config** node MUST be replaced with your own Data Table's ID before this workflow can do anything, in every run, not just for testing.

**How to set it up:**
1. Create a Data Table in your n8n instance (Data Tables → New), name it `jobops_template_config`.
2. Add one row with a column for every base/table ID your own Airtable base uses (e.g. baseId, tableReviews).
3. Open the **Load Config** node in this workflow → click into the Data Table field → select your new table. This replaces the placeholder with your table's real ID.

**Important:** this workflow is exported with the placeholder still in place. It will fail (harmlessly) until you fill in your real Data Table ID. After editing it, you must **republish this workflow** for the change to take effect — editing alone only updates the draft, not what's actually running.

## Setup required: jobops_template_reviews_digests Data Table ID (always, no exceptions)

This workflow looks up the sent digest message's mapping back to its Reviews record (D-22) via the **Lookup Digest Record** node, so this reply can be matched to the right record. The placeholder `YOUR_JOBOPS_TEMPLATE_REVIEWS_DIGESTS_DATA_TABLE_ID` MUST be replaced with your own Data Table's ID before this workflow can do anything, in every run, not just for testing.

**How to set it up:**
1. Create a second Data Table in your n8n instance, name it `jobops_template_reviews_digests`, with columns `messageId` and `reviewsRecordId`.
2. Open the **Lookup Digest Record** node → click into the Data Table field → select your new table. This replaces the placeholder with your table's real ID.
3. Use the same table's ID in **JobOps Template - Reviews Digest**'s **Store Digest Message Link** node — both workflows must point at the same table.

**Important:** this workflow is exported with the placeholder still in place. It will fail (harmlessly) until you fill in your real Data Table ID. After editing it, you must **republish this workflow** for the change to take effect — editing alone only updates the draft, not what's actually running.
